decision: Two native experiments are complete; do not add a third timing probe or repeat unchanged captures. Separate DOM/native presentation needs a coherent presentation solution. Reopen that gate Pending; restore acceptance only after a source image with an internal landmark follows its crop outline during motion. Do not count the prior border-only pass as complete alignment proof.
